artist.name: Rick J Berube
artist.bioShort: Self-taught fine artist specializing in oil and acrylic landscapes, seascapes, wildlife, florals, and commissioned portraits. Over 500 original paintings created with passion and dedication.
artist.bioExtended: I became interested in landscape oil painting in the early 1990s, heavily inspired by the great television artist Bob Ross. Watching him every Saturday morning inspired me to paint using the wet-on-wet technique, which remained my primary style for many years. In 2017, I expanded into acrylics, colored pencils, and charcoal, which opened exciting new doors for custom commissions, portraits, wildlife, 3D art, and fan art.
